title: Strict-local representative section pullback
statement: theorem strictLocal_section_pullback (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X' X Y : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)} {f : X ⟶ Y} {s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y} (sq : CommSq g' f' f s) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s) (hpoint : ∀ j : SmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s), t ≫ (Scheme.strictHenselizationCone s).π.app (op (op j)) ≫ (Spec (unop ((equivSmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).1.left)).isoSpec.inv = ((equivSmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).2.left) (q : X' ⟶ pullback f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)) (hqt : q ≫ pullback.snd f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s) = f' ≫ t) (hq : q ≫ pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s) = g') (j : SmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)) : qcqsStrictLocalSectionRestriction Λ f s F j ≫ globalSectionsUpperStarMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) q ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))).obj F) ≫ (Sheaf.Γ _ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map ((upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) q (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)) g' hq.symm).inv.app F) = geometricFibreSectionRestriction Λ sq F ((Scheme.AffineEtale.Spec Y).obj ((equivSmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).1) ((equivSmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).2 ≫ (Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections _ _ (IsTerminal.isTerminalOfObj (MorphismProperty.Over.forget @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ⊤ X') (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X')) Over.mkIdTerminal)).inv.app ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g').obj F)

proof.text:
/-- Pulling a strict-local representative section back to the pointed fibre is the
unit restriction along that representative's marked point.
Source: Stacks Project, Tag 03Q9, canonical restriction on representatives, and
Tag 0A3U, degree-zero compatibility in the parent factorization.
(blueprint: lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-section-pullback).

Proof: expand `qcqsStrictLocalSectionRestriction` and the global-sections pullback.
Naturality of terminal evaluation changes the latter into the unit for q followed
by restriction along its terminal lift. Naturality of the unit moves the strict-local
limit-leg restriction past this unit. The composition-unit identity and the inverse
of `upperStarComp` identify the two successive inverse-image units with the unit for
g'. The remaining morphism from the terminal object to g'^*f^*V has outer second
projection identity. Its inner projections are g', by hq, and f' followed by the
marked point: use hqt to replace the map to the strict-local base by f't, then use
hpoint to replace t followed by the limit leg by the marked point. Pullback hom-ext
therefore identifies this morphism with `geometricFibreSectionLift`. The terminal
section/global-section isomorphisms cancel, leaving exactly the stated identity.
No isomorphism of stalks, comparison map a, qcqs hypothesis, or exchange map occurs.
The argument is valid for empty schemes and zero coefficient modules as well. -/

mathlib_searches.results: Both searches unavailable: Internal Server Error.

mathlib_searches.query: A canonical isomorphism of modules between the stalk of an etale direct image and global sections on the strict henselization base change, with germ formula; exchange compatibility with fibre restriction
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits per query, on structure-sheaf stalk maps in Spec/AffineScheme, Scheme.stalkMap_germ, and ModuleCat.Tilde.germ_comp_stalkToFiberLinearMap. These concern Zariski structure-sheaf or tilde stalks, not the etale direct image or exchange.

12 hits including presheafFiber_hom_ext, toPresheafFiber_naturality, toPresheafFiber_w, and toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberDesc. These are general colimit tools, not the desired etale comparison or exchange identity.

mathlib_searches.query: strictHenselization|baseChangeMap|strictLocal in Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites; qcqs.*[Ss]talk|strictHenselization.*[Cc]omparison|baseChangeMap.*[Gg]erm in the project library
mathlib_searches.results: No Mathlib sites hits and no exact library theorem. The library has the set-valued continuity theorem and the module/set inverse-image comparison; the finite base-change stalk-restriction theorem only computes pointwise restrictions, not the global-section factorization.

mathlib_searches.query: Pullback of a sheaf section along a commutative square agrees with the adjunction unit on a marked etale neighbourhood
mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits, topological sheaf pullback and unrelated scheme/open immersion results; no etale strict-local section formula.
No hits (identifier not known by Mathlib-only loogle).

Found the proved representative calculation in geometricFibreExchange_germs, reused to prove exchange_pointed_representative. No existing strict-local section pullback identity; restriction naturality concerns refinement, not pullback to the fibre.

mathlib_searches.query: Inverse image adjunction unit compatible with restriction of sections along a composite scheme morphism
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: Zariski Scheme.Modules restrictAdjunction/restrictFunctorComp and scheme structure-sheaf appLE maps; none computes strict-local etale module sections.
One generic adjunction uniqueness/unit lemma; it helps identify canonical units but does not give this section-pullback identity.

QcqsStrictLocalRestrictionNaturality concerns neighbourhood refinements only. IntegralFibreSectionLocalLiftAux has a stronger existential integral comparison with sorry, not the canonical arbitrary-q formula. Coherence contains the proved composition-unit identity, but the terminal evaluation and projection calculation remain to be formalized.
